## Jason SharePoint Site Access
Daily app-only discovery registers new AOT sites **Disabled**. An authorized site switch takes effect immediately without code changes, deployments or restarts. Enabling a site does **not** grant write privileges or override document release policy. All changes are audited.

panels.description: Only authorized Owner/admin changes; server must check the exact action.
